ValidationRule.description: Jordan Credit Card Digital Signature (NBA-16140): Signature Verifier Result must match the Sign Type. Use DocuSign is allowed only when Sign Type is Docusign, and Use Digital Signature only when Sign Type is Digital Signature.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Credit Card Application"), ISPICKVAL(Region_Flag__c, "Jordan"), ISCHANGED(cc_Signature_Verifier_Result__c), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(cc_Signature_Verifier_Result__c, "Use DocuSign"), ISPICKVAL(Resend_DocuSign__c, "Digital Signature") ), AND( ISPICKVAL(cc_Signature_Verifier_Result__c, "Use Digital Signature"), ISPICKVAL(Resend_DocuSign__c, "Docusign") ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Signature Verifier Result must match the Sign Type. Select 'Use DocuSign' only when Sign Type is Docusign, and 'Use Digital Signature' only when Sign Type is Digital Signature.
